# PPC Growth Expert

> Independent Amazon PPC Consultancy & Performance Growth Agency founded by Anmol Pokhriyal. Helping e-commerce brands in India, US, UK, and global marketplaces scale Amazon ad revenue, reduce ACoS, maximize ROAS, and optimize unit economics through data-driven PPC strategies.

## Core Services & Solutions
- [Amazon & Marketplace Services Hub](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services/): Comprehensive marketplace activation, catalog management, pricing, inventory, reviews, and returns.
- [Amazon PPC Management Services](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services/amazon-ppc-management-services.html): Dedicated full-funnel PPC management, TACoS reduction, negative harvesting, and campaign structuring.
- [Amazon Advertising in India](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services/amazon-advertising-india.html): Specialized ad management for Amazon India (amazon.in) brands, Sponsored Products, DSP, and festive surge scaling.
- [Amazon PPC Management Services in Noida](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services/amazon-ppc-management-services-noida.html): Localized enterprise Amazon advertising and seller account management in Noida and Delhi NCR.
- [Amazon PPC Management Services in Delhi](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services/amazon-ppc-management-services-delhi.html): Strategic Amazon PPC agency services for direct-to-consumer and manufacturing brands across Delhi.
- [Amazon PPC Management Services in Moradabad](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services/amazon-ppc-management-services-moradabad.html): Amazon global selling and export advertising for handicraft and brassware manufacturing hubs.
- [Ecommerce PPC Services](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services/ecommerce-ppc-services.html): Cross-channel marketplace advertising management across Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart.

## Free Calculators & Tools
- [Amazon ACoS Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-acos-calculator.html): Calculate Advertising Cost of Sales and margin safety thresholds.
- [Amazon ROAS Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-roas-calculator.html): Calculate Return on Ad Spend and campaign revenue multiplier.
- [Amazon PPC Conversion Rate Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-ppc-conversion-rate-calculator.html): Measure order conversion percentage from ad traffic.
- [Amazon CPC Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-cpc-calculator.html): Calculate cost-per-click across keywords and ad groups.
- [Amazon CTR Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-ctr-calculator.html): Evaluate ad creative and placement click-through rate.
- [Amazon TACoS Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-tacos-calculator.html): Compare total advertising cost against total brand revenue.
- [Amazon India Profit Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-profit-calculator.html): Calculate net profit payout, referral fees, closing fees, and 18% GST impact for FBA & MFN in India.
- [Amazon FBA Fee Calculator India](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-fba-fee-calculator.html): Calculate pick & pack, weight handling, and storage fee breakdowns.
- [Amazon FBA Storage Fee Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-fba-storage-fee-calculator.html): Estimate monthly inventory storage costs based on dimensions and sell-through velocity.
- [Amazon Advertising ROI Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/calculators/amazon-advertising-roi-calculator.html): Calculate net ROI after deducting ad spend, COGS, and marketplace fees.
